description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Vesperlark.
When Vesperlark dies, it triggers, returning Activated Sleeper from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Vesperlark.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Activated Sleeper.
When Activated Sleeper dies, it triggers, returning Activated Sleeper from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Vesperlark.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 3.
